note: Literature widely supports the absence of ectopia lentis as a primary discriminator distinguishing Loeys-Dietz syndrome (including SMAD2/LDS6) from Marfan syndrome.

evidence.text: The absence of ectopia lentis is recognized as a key distinguishing feature of Loeys-Dietz syndrome, which includes cases caused by mutations in SMAD2, when compared to Marfan syndrome.

evidence.text: Absence of ectopia lentis serves as a major distinguishing hallmark of Loeys-Dietz syndrome in contrast to Marfan syndrome.
